ko.tours.keypairs.label: 키페어 생성·삭제
ko.tours.keypairs.summary: SSH 키페어를 만들고 목록에서 확인한 뒤 삭제합니다.
ko.tours.keypairs.step1.title: 키페어 생성 열기
ko.tours.keypairs.step1.description: + 키페어 생성 버튼을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.keypairs.step2.title: 이름 입력
ko.tours.keypairs.step2.description: 키페어 이름을 입력하고 '생성'을 누르세요. 공개 키를 비워 두면 새 키가 자동 생성됩니다.
ko.tours.keypairs.step3.title: 개인 키 저장
ko.tours.keypairs.step3.description: 생성된 개인 키는 이번 한 번만 표시됩니다. 안전한 곳에 저장한 뒤 '확인'을 누르세요.
ko.tours.keypairs.step4.title: 새 키페어 삭제
ko.tours.keypairs.step4.description: 방금 만든 키페어가 목록에 추가됐습니다. 이 키페어의 '삭제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.keypairs.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.keypairs.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.floatingIps.label: Floating IP 할당·해제
ko.tours.floatingIps.summary: 외부 네트워크에서 Floating IP를 할당하고 목록에서 확인한 뒤 해제합니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: 할당 창 열기
ko.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: 'Floating IP 할당' 버튼을 눌러 할당 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: 주소 할당
ko.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: 외부 네트워크를 고르라는 안내가 있으면 선택한 뒤 'IP 할당'을 누르세요. 외부 네트워크가 하나뿐이면 자동으로 선택됩니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: 새 주소 확인
ko.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: 새 Floating IP가 목록에 추가됐습니다. 아직 인스턴스에 연결되지 않은 상태입니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: 해제 버튼 누르기
ko.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: 방금 할당한 주소의 '해제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: 해제 확인
ko.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 주소가 외부 네트워크 풀로 반환됩니다.
ko.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: 해제 완료
ko.tours.networks.label: 네트워크 생성·삭제
ko.tours.networks.summary: 프로젝트 네트워크를 만들고 목록에서 찾은 뒤 삭제합니다.
ko.tours.networks.step1.title: 네트워크 생성 열기
ko.tours.networks.step1.description: + 네트워크 생성 버튼을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.networks.step2.title: 이름 입력
ko.tours.networks.step2.description: 네트워크 이름을 입력하고 '생성'을 누르세요. CIDR을 지정해 서브넷을 함께 추가할 수도 있습니다.
ko.tours.networks.step3.title: 새 네트워크 메뉴 열기
ko.tours.networks.step3.description: 방금 만든 네트워크가 목록에 추가됐습니다. 이 네트워크의 ⋮ 메뉴 버튼을 누르세요.
ko.tours.networks.step4.title: 삭제 누르기
ko.tours.networks.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.networks.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.securityGroups.label: 보안 그룹 생성·삭제
ko.tours.securityGroups.summary: 보안 그룹을 만들고 목록에서 열어 본 뒤 삭제합니다.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: 보안 그룹 생성 열기
ko.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: + 보안 그룹 생성 버튼을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: 이름과 설명 입력
ko.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: 그룹 이름(설명은 선택)을 입력하고 '생성'을 누르세요. 새 그룹에는 송신(egress) 규칙만 들어 있습니다.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: 새 그룹 선택
ko.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: 방금 만든 그룹이 목록에 추가됐습니다. 그룹을 눌러 규칙 패널을 여세요.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: 삭제 누르기
ko.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: 규칙 패널 위쪽의 '삭제'를 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 보안 그룹이 삭제됩니다.
ko.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: 삭제 완료

en.tours.keypairs.label: Create·delete key pairs
en.tours.keypairs.summary: Create an SSH key pair, check it in the list, and delete it.
en.tours.keypairs.step1.title: Open key pair creation
en.tours.keypairs.step1.description: Click + Create key pair to open the creation dialog.
en.tours.keypairs.step2.title: Enter a name
en.tours.keypairs.step2.description: Enter a key pair name and click Create. Leave the public key empty to have a new key generated.
en.tours.keypairs.step3.title: Save the private key
en.tours.keypairs.step3.description: The generated private key is shown only once. Save it somewhere safe, then click Confirm.
en.tours.keypairs.step4.title: Delete the new key pair
en.tours.keypairs.step4.description: The key pair you just created is now in the list. Click its Delete button. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.keypairs.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.keypairs.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The key pair is deleted.
en.tours.keypairs.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.keypairs.step6.description: Check that the key pair is gone from the list.
en.tours.floatingIps.label: Allocate·release floating IPs
en.tours.floatingIps.summary: Allocate a floating IP from an external network, check it in the list, and release it.
en.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: Open allocation
en.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: Click Allocate floating IP to open the allocation dialog.
en.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: Allocate an address
en.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: Choose an external network if asked, then click Allocate IP. A single external network is selected automatically.
en.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: Check the new address
en.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: The new floating IP is now in the list. It is not attached to any instance yet.
en.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: Click Release
en.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: Click Release on the address you just allocated. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: Confirm release
en.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The address returns to the external network's pool.
en.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: Release complete
en.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: Check that the address is gone from the list.
en.tours.networks.label: Create·delete networks
en.tours.networks.summary: Create a project network, find it in the list, and delete it.
en.tours.networks.step1.title: Open network creation
en.tours.networks.step1.description: Click + Create network to open the creation dialog.
en.tours.networks.step2.title: Enter a name
en.tours.networks.step2.description: Enter a network name and click Create. You can also add a subnet with a CIDR.
en.tours.networks.step3.title: Open the new network's menu
en.tours.networks.step3.description: The network you just created is now in the list. Click its ⋮ menu button.
en.tours.networks.step4.title: Click Delete
en.tours.networks.step4.description: Click Delete in the menu. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.networks.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.networks.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The network is deleted.
en.tours.networks.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.networks.step6.description: Check that the network is gone from the list.
en.tours.securityGroups.label: Create·delete security groups
en.tours.securityGroups.summary: Create a security group, open it from the list, and delete it.
en.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: Open security group creation
en.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: Click + Create security group to open the creation dialog.
en.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: Enter name and description
en.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: Enter a group name (the description is optional), then click Create. New groups contain only egress rules.
en.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: Select the new group
en.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: The group you just created is now in the list. Click it to open its rules panel.
en.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: Click Delete
en.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: Click Delete at the top of the rules panel. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The security group is deleted.
en.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: Check that the group is gone from the list.

ja.tours.keypairs.label: キーペアの作成・削除
ja.tours.keypairs.summary: SSHキーペアを作成し、一覧で確認してから削除します。
ja.tours.keypairs.step1.title: キーペア作成を開く
ja.tours.keypairs.step1.description: 「+ キーペアを作成」を押して作成ダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.keypairs.step2.title: 名前を入力
ja.tours.keypairs.step2.description: キーペア名を入力して「作成」を押してください。公開鍵を空欄にすると新しい鍵が自動生成されます。
ja.tours.keypairs.step3.title: 秘密鍵を保存
ja.tours.keypairs.step3.description: 生成された秘密鍵は一度だけ表示されます。安全な場所に保存してから「確認」を押してください。
ja.tours.keypairs.step4.title: 新しいキーペアを削除
ja.tours.keypairs.step4.description: 作成したキーペアが一覧に追加されました。そのキーペアの「削除」を押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.keypairs.step5.title: 削除を確認
ja.tours.keypairs.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、キーペアが削除されます。
ja.tours.keypairs.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.keypairs.step6.description: 一覧からキーペアが消えたことを確認してください。
ja.tours.floatingIps.label: Floating IPの割り当て・解放
ja.tours.floatingIps.summary: 外部ネットワークからFloating IPを割り当て、一覧で確認してから解放します。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: 割り当てを開く
ja.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: 「Floating IPを割り当て」を押して割り当てダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: アドレスを割り当て
ja.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: 外部ネットワークの選択を求められたら選び、「IPを割り当て」を押してください。外部ネットワークが1つだけなら自動で選択されます。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: 新しいアドレスを確認
ja.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: 新しいFloating IPが一覧に追加されました。まだインスタンスには接続されていません。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: 解放ボタンを押す
ja.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: 割り当てたアドレスの「解放」を押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: 解放を確認
ja.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、アドレスは外部ネットワークのプールに戻ります。
ja.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: 解放完了
ja.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: 一覧からアドレスが消えたことを確認してください。
ja.tours.networks.label: ネットワークの作成・削除
ja.tours.networks.summary: プロジェクトネットワークを作成し、一覧で見つけてから削除します。
ja.tours.networks.step1.title: ネットワーク作成を開く
ja.tours.networks.step1.description: 「+ ネットワークを作成」を押して作成ダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.networks.step2.title: 名前を入力
ja.tours.networks.step2.description: ネットワーク名を入力して「作成」を押してください。CIDRを指定してサブネットを同時に追加することもできます。
ja.tours.networks.step3.title: 新しいネットワークのメニューを開く
ja.tours.networks.step3.description: 作成したネットワークが一覧に追加されました。そのネットワークの ⋮ メニューボタンを押してください。
ja.tours.networks.step4.title: 削除を押す
ja.tours.networks.step4.description: メニューの「削除」を押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.networks.step5.title: 削除を確認
ja.tours.networks.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、ネットワークが削除されます。
ja.tours.networks.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.networks.step6.description: 一覧からネットワークが消えたことを確認してください。
ja.tours.securityGroups.label: セキュリティーグループの作成・削除
ja.tours.securityGroups.summary: セキュリティーグループを作成し、一覧から開いて削除します。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: セキュリティーグループ作成を開く
ja.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: 「+ セキュリティーグループを作成」を押して作成ダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: 名前と説明を入力
ja.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: グループ名(説明は任意)を入力して「作成」を押してください。新しいグループには送信(egress)ルールだけが含まれます。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: 新しいグループを選択
ja.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: 作成したグループが一覧に追加されました。グループを押してルールパネルを開いてください。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: 削除を押す
ja.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: ルールパネル上部の「削除」を押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: 削除を確認
ja.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、セキュリティーグループが削除されます。
ja.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: 一覧からグループが消えたことを確認してください。

zh-CN.tours.keypairs.label: 创建·删除密钥对
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.summary: 创建 SSH 密钥对，在列表中确认后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step1.title: 打开密钥对创建
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建密钥对”打开创建对话框。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step2.title: 输入名称
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step2.description: 输入密钥对名称并点击“创建”。公钥留空时会自动生成新密钥。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step3.title: 保存私钥
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step3.description: 生成的私钥只显示一次。请妥善保存，然后点击“确认”。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step4.title: 删除新密钥对
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step4.description: 刚创建的密钥对已出现在列表中。点击它的“删除”按钮，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，密钥对即被删除。
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.keypairs.step6.description: 确认该密钥对已从列表中消失。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.label: 分配·释放浮动 IP
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.summary: 从外部网络分配浮动 IP，在列表中确认后将其释放。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: 打开分配
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: 点击“分配浮动 IP”打开分配对话框。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: 分配地址
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: 如提示选择外部网络，请先选择，然后点击“分配 IP”。只有一个外部网络时会自动选中。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: 查看新地址
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: 新的浮动 IP 已出现在列表中，目前尚未关联到任何实例。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: 点击释放
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: 点击刚分配地址的“释放”按钮，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: 确认释放
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，地址将归还到外部网络地址池。
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: 释放完成
zh-CN.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: 确认该地址已从列表中消失。
zh-CN.tours.networks.label: 创建·删除网络
zh-CN.tours.networks.summary: 创建项目网络，在列表中找到后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step1.title: 打开网络创建
zh-CN.tours.networks.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建网络”打开创建对话框。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step2.title: 输入名称
zh-CN.tours.networks.step2.description: 输入网络名称并点击“创建”。也可以指定 CIDR 同时添加子网。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step3.title: 打开新网络的菜单
zh-CN.tours.networks.step3.description: 刚创建的网络已出现在列表中。点击它的 ⋮ 菜单按钮。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step4.title: 点击删除
zh-CN.tours.networks.step4.description: 在菜单中点击“删除”，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.networks.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，网络即被删除。
zh-CN.tours.networks.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.networks.step6.description: 确认该网络已从列表中消失。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.label: 创建·删除安全组
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.summary: 创建安全组，从列表中打开后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: 打开安全组创建
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建安全组”打开创建对话框。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: 输入名称和描述
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: 输入安全组名称（描述可选）并点击“创建”。新安全组只包含出站（egress）规则。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: 选择新安全组
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: 刚创建的安全组已出现在列表中。点击它以打开规则面板。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: 点击删除
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: 点击规则面板顶部的“删除”，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，安全组即被删除。
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: 确认该安全组已从列表中消失。

bn.tours.keypairs.label: কী-পেয়ার তৈরি ও মুছুন
bn.tours.keypairs.summary: একটি SSH কী-পেয়ার তৈরি করুন, তালিকায় দেখে নিন, তারপর মুছে ফেলুন।
bn.tours.keypairs.step1.title: কী-পেয়ার তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.keypairs.step1.description: + কী-পেয়ার তৈরি করুন বোতামে ক্লিক করে তৈরির ডায়ালগ খুলুন।
bn.tours.keypairs.step2.title: নাম লিখুন
bn.tours.keypairs.step2.description: কী-পেয়ারের নাম লিখে “তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করুন। পাবলিক কী ফাঁকা রাখলে নতুন কী স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে তৈরি হবে।
bn.tours.keypairs.step3.title: প্রাইভেট কী সংরক্ষণ করুন
bn.tours.keypairs.step3.description: তৈরি হওয়া প্রাইভেট কী শুধু একবারই দেখানো হয়। নিরাপদ জায়গায় সংরক্ষণ করে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.keypairs.step4.title: নতুন কী-পেয়ার মুছুন
bn.tours.keypairs.step4.description: এইমাত্র তৈরি কী-পেয়ারটি তালিকায় যুক্ত হয়েছে। এর “মুছুন” বোতামে ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.keypairs.step5.title: মোছা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.keypairs.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে কী-পেয়ারটি মুছে যাবে।
bn.tours.keypairs.step6.title: মোছা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.keypairs.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে কী-পেয়ারটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।
bn.tours.floatingIps.label: Floating IP বরাদ্দ ও ছেড়ে দিন
bn.tours.floatingIps.summary: বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্ক থেকে একটি Floating IP বরাদ্দ করুন, তালিকায় দেখে নিন, তারপর ছেড়ে দিন।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: বরাদ্দ খুলুন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: “Floating IP বরাদ্দ করুন” বোতামে ক্লিক করে বরাদ্দের ডায়ালগ খুলুন।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: ঠিকানা বরাদ্দ করুন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্ক বেছে নিতে বলা হলে বেছে নিন, তারপর “IP বরাদ্দ করুন” ক্লিক করুন। একটিমাত্র বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্ক থাকলে সেটি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে নির্বাচিত হয়।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: নতুন ঠিকানা দেখুন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: নতুন Floating IP তালিকায় যুক্ত হয়েছে। এটি এখনো কোনো ইনস্ট্যান্সের সঙ্গে যুক্ত নয়।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: ছেড়ে দিন ক্লিক করুন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: এইমাত্র বরাদ্দ করা ঠিকানার “ছেড়ে দিন” বোতামে ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: ছেড়ে দেওয়া নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে ঠিকানাটি বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্কের পুলে ফিরে যাবে।
bn.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: ছেড়ে দেওয়া সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে ঠিকানাটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।
bn.tours.networks.label: নেটওয়ার্ক তৈরি ও মুছুন
bn.tours.networks.summary: একটি প্রকল্প নেটওয়ার্ক তৈরি করুন, তালিকায় খুঁজে নিন, তারপর মুছে ফেলুন।
bn.tours.networks.step1.title: নেটওয়ার্ক তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.networks.step1.description: + নেটওয়ার্ক তৈরি করুন বোতামে ক্লিক করে তৈরির ডায়ালগ খুলুন।
bn.tours.networks.step2.title: নাম লিখুন
bn.tours.networks.step2.description: নেটওয়ার্কের নাম লিখে “তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করুন। চাইলে CIDR দিয়ে একটি সাবনেটও যোগ করতে পারেন।
bn.tours.networks.step3.title: নতুন নেটওয়ার্কের মেনু খুলুন
bn.tours.networks.step3.description: এইমাত্র তৈরি নেটওয়ার্কটি তালিকায় যুক্ত হয়েছে। এর ⋮ মেনু বোতামে ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.networks.step4.title: মুছুন ক্লিক করুন
bn.tours.networks.step4.description: মেনুতে “মুছুন” ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.networks.step5.title: মোছা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.networks.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে নেটওয়ার্কটি মুছে যাবে।
bn.tours.networks.step6.title: মোছা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.networks.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে নেটওয়ার্কটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।
bn.tours.securityGroups.label: নিরাপত্তা গ্রুপ তৈরি ও মুছুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.summary: একটি নিরাপত্তা গ্রুপ তৈরি করুন, তালিকা থেকে খুলুন, তারপর মুছে ফেলুন।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: নিরাপত্তা গ্রুপ তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: + নিরাপত্তা গ্রুপ তৈরি করুন বোতামে ক্লিক করে তৈরির ডায়ালগ খুলুন।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: নাম ও বিবরণ লিখুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: গ্রুপের নাম (বিবরণ ঐচ্ছিক) লিখে “তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করুন। নতুন গ্রুপে শুধু বহির্গামী (egress) নিয়ম থাকে।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: নতুন গ্রুপ নির্বাচন করুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: এইমাত্র তৈরি গ্রুপটি তালিকায় যুক্ত হয়েছে। নিয়মের প্যানেল খুলতে গ্রুপটিতে ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: মুছে ফেলুন ক্লিক করুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: নিয়মের প্যানেলের ওপরে “মুছে ফেলুন” ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: মোছা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে নিরাপত্তা গ্রুপটি মুছে যাবে।
bn.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: মোছা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে গ্রুপটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।

ms.tours.keypairs.label: Cipta·padam pasangan kunci
ms.tours.keypairs.summary: Cipta pasangan kunci SSH, semak dalam senarai, kemudian padamkannya.
ms.tours.keypairs.step1.title: Buka penciptaan pasangan kunci
ms.tours.keypairs.step1.description: Klik + Cipta pasangan kunci untuk membuka dialog penciptaan.
ms.tours.keypairs.step2.title: Masukkan nama
ms.tours.keypairs.step2.description: Masukkan nama pasangan kunci dan klik Cipta. Biarkan kunci awam kosong untuk menjana kunci baharu.
ms.tours.keypairs.step3.title: Simpan kunci peribadi
ms.tours.keypairs.step3.description: Kunci peribadi yang dijana hanya dipaparkan sekali. Simpan di tempat selamat, kemudian klik Sahkan.
ms.tours.keypairs.step4.title: Padam pasangan kunci baharu
ms.tours.keypairs.step4.description: Pasangan kunci yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai. Klik butang Padam padanya. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.keypairs.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.keypairs.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Pasangan kunci akan dipadam.
ms.tours.keypairs.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.keypairs.step6.description: Semak bahawa pasangan kunci tidak lagi ada dalam senarai.
ms.tours.floatingIps.label: Peruntuk·lepas IP terapung
ms.tours.floatingIps.summary: Peruntukkan IP terapung daripada rangkaian luaran, semak dalam senarai, kemudian lepaskannya.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: Buka peruntukan
ms.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: Klik Peruntukkan IP terapung untuk membuka dialog peruntukan.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: Peruntukkan alamat
ms.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: Pilih rangkaian luaran jika diminta, kemudian klik Peruntukkan IP. Jika hanya ada satu rangkaian luaran, ia dipilih secara automatik.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: Semak alamat baharu
ms.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: IP terapung baharu kini ada dalam senarai. Ia belum dikaitkan dengan mana-mana instans.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: Klik Lepaskan
ms.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: Klik Lepaskan pada alamat yang baru diperuntukkan. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: Sahkan pelepasan
ms.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Alamat dikembalikan ke kolam rangkaian luaran.
ms.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: Pelepasan selesai
ms.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: Semak bahawa alamat tidak lagi ada dalam senarai.
ms.tours.networks.label: Cipta·padam rangkaian
ms.tours.networks.summary: Cipta rangkaian projek, cari dalam senarai, kemudian padamkannya.
ms.tours.networks.step1.title: Buka penciptaan rangkaian
ms.tours.networks.step1.description: Klik + Cipta rangkaian untuk membuka dialog penciptaan.
ms.tours.networks.step2.title: Masukkan nama
ms.tours.networks.step2.description: Masukkan nama rangkaian dan klik Cipta. Anda juga boleh menambah subnet dengan CIDR.
ms.tours.networks.step3.title: Buka menu rangkaian baharu
ms.tours.networks.step3.description: Rangkaian yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai. Klik butang menu ⋮ padanya.
ms.tours.networks.step4.title: Klik Padam
ms.tours.networks.step4.description: Klik Padam dalam menu. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.networks.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.networks.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Rangkaian akan dipadam.
ms.tours.networks.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.networks.step6.description: Semak bahawa rangkaian tidak lagi ada dalam senarai.
ms.tours.securityGroups.label: Cipta·padam kumpulan keselamatan
ms.tours.securityGroups.summary: Cipta kumpulan keselamatan, bukanya dari senarai, kemudian padamkannya.
ms.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: Buka penciptaan kumpulan keselamatan
ms.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: Klik + Cipta kumpulan keselamatan untuk membuka dialog penciptaan.
ms.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: Masukkan nama dan keterangan
ms.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: Masukkan nama kumpulan (keterangan adalah pilihan), kemudian klik Cipta. Kumpulan baharu hanya mempunyai peraturan keluar (egress).
ms.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: Pilih kumpulan baharu
ms.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: Kumpulan yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai. Klik kumpulan itu untuk membuka panel peraturannya.
ms.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: Klik Padam
ms.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: Klik Padam di bahagian atas panel peraturan. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Kumpulan keselamatan akan dipadam.
ms.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: Semak bahawa kumpulan tidak lagi ada dalam senarai.

nb.tours.keypairs.label: Opprett og slett nøkkelpar
nb.tours.keypairs.summary: Opprett et SSH-nøkkelpar, sjekk det i listen og slett det.
nb.tours.keypairs.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av nøkkelpar
nb.tours.keypairs.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett nøkkelpar for å åpne opprettingsdialogen.
nb.tours.keypairs.step2.title: Skriv inn et navn
nb.tours.keypairs.step2.description: Skriv inn et navn på nøkkelparet og klikk Opprett. La den offentlige nøkkelen stå tom for å generere en ny nøkkel.
nb.tours.keypairs.step3.title: Lagre den private nøkkelen
nb.tours.keypairs.step3.description: Den genererte private nøkkelen vises bare én gang. Lagre den på et trygt sted, og klikk deretter Bekreft.
nb.tours.keypairs.step4.title: Slett det nye nøkkelparet
nb.tours.keypairs.step4.description: Nøkkelparet du nettopp opprettet, står nå i listen. Klikk Slett på det. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.keypairs.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.keypairs.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Nøkkelparet slettes.
nb.tours.keypairs.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.keypairs.step6.description: Kontroller at nøkkelparet er borte fra listen.
nb.tours.floatingIps.label: Tildel og frigi flytende IP
nb.tours.floatingIps.summary: Tildel en flytende IP fra et eksternt nettverk, sjekk den i listen og frigi den.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: Åpne tildeling
nb.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: Klikk Tildel flytende IP for å åpne tildelingsdialogen.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: Tildel en adresse
nb.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: Velg et eksternt nettverk hvis du blir bedt om det, og klikk deretter Tildel IP. Finnes det bare ett eksternt nettverk, velges det automatisk.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: Sjekk den nye adressen
nb.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: Den nye flytende IP-adressen står nå i listen. Den er ennå ikke knyttet til noen instans.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: Klikk Frigi
nb.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: Klikk Frigi på adressen du nettopp tildelte. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: Bekreft frigiving
nb.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Adressen går tilbake til det eksterne nettverkets adressebasseng.
nb.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: Frigiving fullført
nb.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: Kontroller at adressen er borte fra listen.
nb.tours.networks.label: Opprett og slett nettverk
nb.tours.networks.summary: Opprett et prosjektnettverk, finn det i listen og slett det.
nb.tours.networks.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av nettverk
nb.tours.networks.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett nettverk for å åpne opprettingsdialogen.
nb.tours.networks.step2.title: Skriv inn et navn
nb.tours.networks.step2.description: Skriv inn et nettverksnavn og klikk Opprett. Du kan også legge til et subnett med en CIDR.
nb.tours.networks.step3.title: Åpne menyen for det nye nettverket
nb.tours.networks.step3.description: Nettverket du nettopp opprettet, står nå i listen. Klikk på menyknappen ⋮ for det.
nb.tours.networks.step4.title: Klikk Slett
nb.tours.networks.step4.description: Klikk Slett i menyen. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.networks.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.networks.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Nettverket slettes.
nb.tours.networks.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.networks.step6.description: Kontroller at nettverket er borte fra listen.
nb.tours.securityGroups.label: Opprett og slett sikkerhetsgrupper
nb.tours.securityGroups.summary: Opprett en sikkerhetsgruppe, åpne den fra listen og slett den.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av sikkerhetsgruppe
nb.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett sikkerhetsgruppe for å åpne opprettingsdialogen.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: Skriv inn navn og beskrivelse
nb.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: Skriv inn et gruppenavn (beskrivelse er valgfritt) og klikk Opprett. Nye grupper har bare utgående (egress) regler.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: Velg den nye gruppen
nb.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: Gruppen du nettopp opprettet, står nå i listen. Klikk på den for å åpne regelpanelet.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: Klikk Slett
nb.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: Klikk Slett øverst i regelpanelet. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Sikkerhetsgruppen slettes.
nb.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: Kontroller at gruppen er borte fra listen.

sw.tours.keypairs.label: Unda na futa jozi za funguo
sw.tours.keypairs.summary: Unda jozi ya funguo za SSH, ikague kwenye orodha, kisha uifute.
sw.tours.keypairs.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa jozi ya funguo
sw.tours.keypairs.step1.description: Bofya + Unda jozi ya funguo kufungua kisanduku cha kuunda.
sw.tours.keypairs.step2.title: Weka jina
sw.tours.keypairs.step2.description: Weka jina la jozi ya funguo, kisha ubofye Unda. Acha ufunguo wa umma wazi ili ufunguo mpya utengenezwe.
sw.tours.keypairs.step3.title: Hifadhi ufunguo wa faragha
sw.tours.keypairs.step3.description: Ufunguo wa faragha uliotengenezwa unaonyeshwa mara moja tu. Uhifadhi mahali salama, kisha ubofye Thibitisha.
sw.tours.keypairs.step4.title: Futa jozi mpya ya funguo
sw.tours.keypairs.step4.description: Jozi ya funguo uliyoiunda sasa iko kwenye orodha. Bofya kitufe chake cha Futa. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.keypairs.step5.title: Thibitisha ufutaji
sw.tours.keypairs.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Jozi ya funguo itafutwa.
sw.tours.keypairs.step6.title: Ufutaji umekamilika
sw.tours.keypairs.step6.description: Thibitisha kuwa jozi ya funguo haionekani tena kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.floatingIps.label: Tenga na achilia Floating IP
sw.tours.floatingIps.summary: Tenga Floating IP kutoka kwenye mtandao wa nje, ikague kwenye orodha, kisha uiachilie.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: Fungua utengaji
sw.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: Bofya Tenga Floating IP kufungua kisanduku cha kutenga.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: Tenga anwani
sw.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: Chagua mtandao wa nje ukiombwa, kisha ubofye Tenga IP. Ikiwa kuna mtandao mmoja tu wa nje, unachaguliwa kiotomatiki.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: Kagua anwani mpya
sw.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: Floating IP mpya sasa iko kwenye orodha. Bado haijaunganishwa na instansi yoyote.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: Bofya Achilia
sw.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: Bofya Achilia kwenye anwani uliyoitenga. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: Thibitisha kuachilia
sw.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Anwani inarudi kwenye hifadhi ya anwani za mtandao wa nje.
sw.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: Kuachilia kumekamilika
sw.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: Thibitisha kuwa anwani haionekani tena kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.networks.label: Unda na futa mitandao
sw.tours.networks.summary: Unda mtandao wa mradi, uutafute kwenye orodha, kisha uufute.
sw.tours.networks.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa mtandao
sw.tours.networks.step1.description: Bofya + Unda mtandao kufungua kisanduku cha kuunda.
sw.tours.networks.step2.title: Weka jina
sw.tours.networks.step2.description: Weka jina la mtandao, kisha ubofye Unda. Unaweza pia kuongeza subnet kwa CIDR.
sw.tours.networks.step3.title: Fungua menyu ya mtandao mpya
sw.tours.networks.step3.description: Mtandao uliouunda sasa uko kwenye orodha. Bofya kitufe chake cha menyu ⋮.
sw.tours.networks.step4.title: Bofya Futa
sw.tours.networks.step4.description: Bofya Futa kwenye menyu. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.networks.step5.title: Thibitisha ufutaji
sw.tours.networks.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Mtandao utafutwa.
sw.tours.networks.step6.title: Ufutaji umekamilika
sw.tours.networks.step6.description: Thibitisha kuwa mtandao hauonekani tena kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.securityGroups.label: Unda na futa vikundi vya usalama
sw.tours.securityGroups.summary: Unda kikundi cha usalama, kifungue kutoka kwenye orodha, kisha ukifute.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa kikundi cha usalama
sw.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: Bofya + Unda kikundi cha usalama kufungua kisanduku cha kuunda.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: Weka jina na maelezo
sw.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: Weka jina la kikundi (maelezo ni hiari), kisha ubofye Unda. Vikundi vipya vina sheria za kutoka (egress) pekee.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: Chagua kikundi kipya
sw.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: Kikundi ulichokiunda sasa kiko kwenye orodha. Kibofye ili kufungua paneli yake ya sheria.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: Bofya Futa
sw.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: Bofya Futa juu ya paneli ya sheria. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: Thibitisha ufutaji
sw.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Kikundi cha usalama kitafutwa.
sw.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: Ufutaji umekamilika
sw.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: Thibitisha kuwa kikundi hakionekani tena kwenye orodha.

vi.tours.keypairs.label: Tạo·xóa cặp khóa
vi.tours.keypairs.summary: Tạo một cặp khóa SSH, kiểm tra trong danh sách rồi xóa nó.
vi.tours.keypairs.step1.title: Mở tạo cặp khóa
vi.tours.keypairs.step1.description: Nhấp + Tạo cặp khóa để mở hộp thoại tạo.
vi.tours.keypairs.step2.title: Nhập tên
vi.tours.keypairs.step2.description: Nhập tên cặp khóa rồi nhấp Tạo. Để trống khóa công khai để tự động tạo khóa mới.
vi.tours.keypairs.step3.title: Lưu khóa riêng tư
vi.tours.keypairs.step3.description: Khóa riêng tư được tạo chỉ hiển thị một lần. Hãy lưu ở nơi an toàn rồi nhấp Xác nhận.
vi.tours.keypairs.step4.title: Xóa cặp khóa mới
vi.tours.keypairs.step4.description: Cặp khóa bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách. Nhấp nút Xóa của nó. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.keypairs.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.keypairs.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Cặp khóa sẽ bị xóa.
vi.tours.keypairs.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.keypairs.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng cặp khóa đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
vi.tours.floatingIps.label: Cấp phát·giải phóng IP nổi
vi.tours.floatingIps.summary: Cấp phát một IP nổi từ mạng bên ngoài, kiểm tra trong danh sách rồi giải phóng nó.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step1.title: Mở cấp phát
vi.tours.floatingIps.step1.description: Nhấp Cấp phát IP nổi để mở hộp thoại cấp phát.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step2.title: Cấp phát địa chỉ
vi.tours.floatingIps.step2.description: Chọn mạng bên ngoài nếu được hỏi, rồi nhấp Cấp phát IP. Nếu chỉ có một mạng bên ngoài, mạng đó được chọn tự động.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step3.title: Kiểm tra địa chỉ mới
vi.tours.floatingIps.step3.description: IP nổi mới đã có trong danh sách. Địa chỉ này chưa được liên kết với phiên bản máy nào.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step4.title: Nhấp Giải phóng
vi.tours.floatingIps.step4.description: Nhấp Giải phóng trên địa chỉ bạn vừa cấp phát. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step5.title: Xác nhận giải phóng
vi.tours.floatingIps.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Địa chỉ được trả về nhóm địa chỉ của mạng bên ngoài.
vi.tours.floatingIps.step6.title: Đã giải phóng xong
vi.tours.floatingIps.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng địa chỉ đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
vi.tours.networks.label: Tạo·xóa mạng
vi.tours.networks.summary: Tạo một mạng dự án, tìm nó trong danh sách rồi xóa nó.
vi.tours.networks.step1.title: Mở tạo mạng
vi.tours.networks.step1.description: Nhấp + Tạo mạng để mở hộp thoại tạo.
vi.tours.networks.step2.title: Nhập tên
vi.tours.networks.step2.description: Nhập tên mạng rồi nhấp Tạo. Bạn cũng có thể thêm mạng con với một CIDR.
vi.tours.networks.step3.title: Mở menu của mạng mới
vi.tours.networks.step3.description: Mạng bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách. Nhấp nút menu ⋮ của nó.
vi.tours.networks.step4.title: Nhấp Xóa
vi.tours.networks.step4.description: Nhấp Xóa trong menu. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.networks.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.networks.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Mạng sẽ bị xóa.
vi.tours.networks.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.networks.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng mạng đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
vi.tours.securityGroups.label: Tạo·xóa nhóm bảo mật
vi.tours.securityGroups.summary: Tạo một nhóm bảo mật, mở nó từ danh sách rồi xóa nó.
vi.tours.securityGroups.step1.title: Mở tạo nhóm bảo mật
vi.tours.securityGroups.step1.description: Nhấp + Tạo nhóm bảo mật để mở hộp thoại tạo.
vi.tours.securityGroups.step2.title: Nhập tên và mô tả
vi.tours.securityGroups.step2.description: Nhập tên nhóm (mô tả là tùy chọn) rồi nhấp Tạo. Nhóm mới chỉ có các quy tắc đi ra (egress).
vi.tours.securityGroups.step3.title: Chọn nhóm mới
vi.tours.securityGroups.step3.description: Nhóm bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách. Nhấp vào nhóm để mở bảng quy tắc.
vi.tours.securityGroups.step4.title: Nhấp Xóa
vi.tours.securityGroups.step4.description: Nhấp Xóa ở đầu bảng quy tắc. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.securityGroups.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.securityGroups.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Nhóm bảo mật sẽ bị xóa.
vi.tours.securityGroups.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.securityGroups.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng nhóm đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
